name: bot-bridge-board
description: Optional. Connects Claude Code to your own Claude Bot Bridge task board (a remote MCP server) as the owner, so you can hand tasks to Muse while the Mac is closed.

board_url.title: Board URL
board_url.description: Your board's MCP endpoint, ending in /mcp (for example https://<your-worker>.workers.dev/mcp).

owner_key.title: Owner key
owner_key.description: The board's owner key. Stored in your system's secure credential store, never in settings.json. Never give this key to Muse.
